riley-marketing: Quick planning thread  CloudPartner marketplace listing goes live week of June 22. We want a joint webinar + co-auth blog + short benchmark. Need owners for: webinar runbook, demo, landing page & benchmarks, and inbound lead routing.

sam-integ: I can own the demo and fallback video. Need partner sandbox creds by Tue. Will prepare a 5m live flow + 5m pre-recorded clip.

ash-growth: I'll own the benchmark narrative and landing copy. Aim for three headline numbers: p99 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and steady-state throughput. Need a reproducible command snippet and tokenized sample.

kai-pm: I'll do run-of-show and speaker invites. Suggest 40m main webinar + 20m optional hands-on lab. Schedule 2 rehearsals: internal & partner.

lee-partnerops: For leads: utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=cp_launch_jun22. SFDC mapping ready: Lead.Source, Partner__c, CoMarketing__c. SLA: triage in 24 business hours. I'll make queue: CP_Launch_Jun22. Add boolean Demo_Attended.

riley-marketing: Thanks. Action list: 1) Sam  demo + fallback + rehearsals, 2) Ash  benchmark + landing + social snippets, 3) Kai  run-of-show + speakers, 4) Lee  SFDC routing & nurture template. I'll draft co-auth blog outline and short social video storyboard and post here.

notify-bot: Event created: "CloudPartner x Redwood: Launch Webinar" 2026-06-22T17:00:00Z. Invitees: riley-marketing, sam-integ, ash-growth, kai-pm, lee-partnerops, cloudpartner-pm.

ash-growth: For benchmark reproducibility, @sam-integ can you add CLI sample like `redwoodctl demo --model rwd-2b --input samples/market/tokenized.json --preset cp-launch` and note avg seq len ~128?

sam-integ: Yes, will commit sample and command.

lee-partnerops: Nurture email template request: please keep to 3 lines (product + CTA + trial link). Ill use it in the partner workflow.

riley-marketing: Will drop a 3-line draft by EOD. Also planning a 30s explainer clip for marketplace banner. Ash, can you draft technical and exec social variants?

ash-growth: On it. I'll prepare 3 copy variants and a short methodology blurb for the benchmark.

kai-pm: Rehearsals: internal dry-run 06/18 10am PT, partner dress 06/19 9am PT. Sam please post invites.

sam-integ: Posted invites.

riley-marketing: Great work team. Please update this thread when items are complete. :rocket:
